
# 
::: {.page-section .about-section #about}

.leaf-shape {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 60% 40% 60% 40%;
  background: rgba(91, 137, 91, 0.25);
  animation: floatLeaf 10s ease-in-out infinite;
  z-index: 1;
  filter: blur(2px);
}

/* 超大主叶子（视觉核心） */
.leaf-one {
  width: 420px;
  height: 420px;
  top: 5%;
  right: 10%;
}

/* 中等 */
.leaf-two {
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;
  bottom: 5%;
  left: 5%;
  animation-delay: 2s;
}

/* 小的（增加层次） */
.leaf-three {
  width: 160px;
  height: 160px;
  top: 50%;
  right: 35%;
  animation-delay: 4s;
}
@keyframes floatLeaf {
  0% {
    transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-60px) rotate(15deg);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg);
  }
}
